command: Saccharomyces cerevisiae Kdx1/Mlp1 (P36005, YKL161C) regulates cell cycle, participates in G1/S or G2/M transitions, belongs to a cyclin-dependent protein kinase holoenzyme complex, or binds ATP. Adjudicate each independently. Its noncatalytic CWI-Swi4/Swi6 transcription role and pseudokinase sequence are established; determine whether these entail retention, divergence or absence of the candidate functions. Separate loss of phosphotransfer from ATP binding, regulatory process participation and noncatalytic complex membership. Read full primary experiments including PMID:18268013, PMID:20641022 and PMID:20489023, distinguish the nuclear-pore MLP1 namesake, and inspect PAINT nodes PTN001172579/PTN000623979/PTN000623980 relevant to leaf PTN000623199. A NOT at another fungal node PTN008603245 must not be applied to this target unless ancestry is established. Lack of a target assay or a specialized CWI role alone does not refute inherited functions.
